name: Rody and Mastico 2
reason: PP's archive has no RUNME.TOS (its HAGE module, floppy image and T14AG.FIC are there); with Rody and Mastico 4's RUNME.TOS (RODYM4.ZIP, the same layout) it reaches its title and chapter menu from the GEMDOS drive (tools/dev/builds/survey/trials/rodym2/)

name: Ice and Fire
reason: no hard-disk version: three floppy images for a virtual floppy driver (PP's page: not made into a hard-disk version, its disk change detection being unusual); settled by a run with a virtual floppy driver from the GEMDOS drive

name: Great Giana Sisters STE
reason: its music streams from GS.RAW's sectors during play: GIAACSI.TOS finds them through the driver's PUN info and reads them with the ACSI/IDE registers, and prints "Error in getting file location" on a GEMDOS drive (STE TOS 1.62); the page's HAGA downloads GIANAA.ZIP and GIANAS.ZIP do the same (runs-other.tsv: the same error from the GEMDOS drive, the intro from PPDRIVER); running it needs a new music streamer that reads through GEMDOS

name: Crystals of Arborea
reason: START.PRG asks BIOS Getbpb for C: before every file and waits until it gets a BPB; a GEMDOS drive has none (TOS answers 0); with Getbpb(2) answered by a routine put in by the debugger it loads its 39 files and plays (trials/20261013-112306-st-104-gemdrive-1698-crystals-bpb-2)

name: Targhan
reason: the same START.PRG as Crystals of Arborea (ARBOTARG.ZIP); with Getbpb(2) answered it loads 52 files and plays (trials/20261013-112427-st-104-gemdrive-1699-targhan-bpb)

name: Robinsons Requiem
reason: Getbpb on C: before every file, as Crystals of Arborea; with Getbpb(2) answered it reaches its language choice, as from PPDRIVER (trials/20261013-112427-st-104-gemdrive-1774-robinson-bpb)

name: Spy vs Spy 2
reason: SPY2.PRG gives back the memory its stack is in (Mshrink) and starts SPY2.BOY; Hatari's Pexec clears the new program's free memory (no fastload bit), the caller's stack with it, and TOS reads the Pexec as Pterm0 (trials/spy2/runs/20261013-112912-st-104-gemdrive-spy2-usp); with SPY2.BOY's fastload bit set it plays its demo (trials/spy2/runs/20261013-112748-st-104-gemdrive-spy2-fastload)

name: Storm Master
reason: Getbpb on C: before every file, as Crystals of Arborea; with Getbpb(2) answered it reaches its title, as from PPDRIVER (trials/20261013-112427-st-104-gemdrive-1808-storm-bpb)

name: Strike Force Harrier
reason: the same as Spy vs Spy 2: START.TOS's Pexec of HARRIER.TOS ends it from the GEMDOS drive; with HARRIER.TOS's fastload bit set it reaches its simulation menu (trials/sfh/runs/20261013-112833-st-104-gemdrive-sfh-fastload)

name: Aquanaut
reason: the same as Spy vs Spy 2: its Pexec of AQUANAUT.EXE ends it from the GEMDOS drive; with AQUANAUT.EXE's fastload bit set it reaches its title (trials/aquanaut/runs/20261013-113519-st-104-gemdrive-aquanaut-fastload)
